name: @ui-checker/runtime
description: Dev-only runtime that stamps DOM nodes with their React source location so ui-checker can jump to exact source.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/index.js --format=cjs --platform=browser && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/index.mjs --format=esm --platform=browser && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --outDir dist src/index.ts
